definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: transformedKernel
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region: def transformedKernel (x : ℝ) : ℝ := Real.log (1 + x) / (2 + x)

definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: logCoeff
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region: def logCoeff (i : ℕ) : ℝ := -((-1 : ℝ) ^ (i + 1)) / ((i : ℝ) + 1)

definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: reciprocalCoeff
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region: def reciprocalCoeff (j : ℕ) : ℝ := (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (-1 / 2 : ℝ) ^ j

definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: logPolynomial
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region:
def logPolynomial (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, logCoeff i * x ^ (i + 1)

definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: reciprocalPolynomial
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region:
def reciprocalPolynomial (m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, reciprocalCoeff j * x ^ j

definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: degree
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region: def degree (i j : ℕ) : ℕ := i + j + 1

definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: coefficient
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region: def coefficient (i j : ℕ) : ℝ := logCoeff i * reciprocalCoeff j

definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: approximant
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region:
def approximant (n m : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m, coefficient i j * x ^ degree i j

definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: logError
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region: def logError (n : ℕ) : ℝ := d ^ (n + 1) / (1 - d)

definitions_abbrevs_structures.name: uniformError
definitions_abbrevs_structures.complete_original_definition_region:
def uniformError (n m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  logError n / 2 + (d + logError n) * reciprocalError m
